## File: facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/examples/speech_recognition/models/vggtransformer.py

Prompts

```
['build a VGGTransformerModel for ASR with VGG convolutional encoder and transformer decoder', 'build a VGGTransformerEncoder with configurable VGG blocks and transformer layers for speech features', 'build a TransformerDecoder with linearized convolution and transformer layers for incremental decoding', 'build a VGGTransformerEncoderOnly model for CTC-based speech recognition without a decoder', 'review the VGGTransformerEncoder forward pass that processes audio features through VGG and transformer layers', 'build a wav2letter convolutional GLU encoder model for speech recognition with configurable conv layers', 'create a W2lConvGluEncoder instance with vocab size, input features, and convolutional layer configuration', 'run a forward pass through the W2lConvGluEncoder with source tokens and sequence lengths', 'review the default convolutional encoder configuration with 17 layers of increasing channel dimensions', 'test the reorder_encoder_out method to reorder encoder output tensors by a new batch order']
```

Usage

```
{'build_VGGTransformerModel': 'build a VGGTransformerModel for ASR with VGG convolutional encoder and transformer decoder', 'build_VGGTransformerEncoder': 'build a VGGTransformerEncoder with configurable VGG blocks and transformer layers for speech features', 'build_TransformerDecoder': 'build a TransformerDecoder with linearized convolution and transformer layers for incremental decoding', 'build_VGGTransformerEncoderOnly': 'build a VGGTransformerEncoderOnly model for CTC-based speech recognition without a decoder', 'review_VGGTransformerEncoder_forward': 'review the VGGTransformerEncoder forward pass that processes audio features through VGG and transformer layers'}
```
